notes.title: spiderman
notes.content: A web-shooter is a fictional wrist-mounted gadget used by the superhero Spider-Man to fire synthetic, high-tensile web fluid.Core Design and MechanicsHardware: Created by Peter Parker, the mechanical device is strapped to his wrists and made of steel parts.Activation Switch: It features a palm trigger that requires a specific, sharp double-tap or heavy pressure (around 65 pounds) from the inner fingers to fire. This design keeps him from accidentally shooting a web when making a fist.Web Fluid: A special chemical formula stored in high-pressure cartridges. The liquid turns into a tough, sticky, and flexible rope the second it hits the open air.Uses and AbilitiesSwing and Travel: Allows Spider-Man to swing fast between tall buildings and travel across the city.Combat and Traps: Used to tie up enemies, blind villains, or create protective shields and parachutes.Character Symbol: Shows Peter Parker's high-level genius and skills in chemistry and engineering
